Jobs & Opportunities...

Current Vacancies

We are looking for an experienced and driven Front of House and Venue Manager for our busy Elephant venue.

Leading the Front of House Team, you will be responsible for the delivery of a first-class audience and visitor experience at Southwark Playhouse. You will work closely with the Sales, Marketing and Communication departments towards delivering excellent service and maximising income. Health and safety is a key part of the role ensuring that all aspects of visitor and staff safety is of paramount importance, keeping abreast of and adhering to theatre policy and wider legislation. The role includes the oversight of all repairs and maintenance issues within the designated front of house areas, as well as a shared responsibly for maintaining building wide systems.

Download the application pack here (183kb, pdf)

Click here to make your application

Deadline: Sunday, 17 May 2026
Interviews: to be held on 21 & 22 May 2026

Are you a skilled and passionate freelance technician looking for exciting and varied opportunities in the theatre industry? Southwark Playhouse is seeking enthusiastic technicians to join our books.

Are you ready to join a fast-paced, busy environment in Elephant & Castle, working across two buildings and three venues? Here at Southwark Playhouse, we are known for hosting a diverse range of productions and have a strong commitment to delivering high-quality performances to our local community.

If you have experience in lighting, sound, stage management, wardrobe, design, or any other technical discipline, we would love to hear from you!

Location: Southwark Playhouse Borough and Southwark Playhouse Elephant, London, Elephant & Castle.

Rate: £12.50 per hour (base rate), all breaks paid.

We pride ourselves on fostering a creative and inclusive environment, where your skills and expertise will be valued and appreciated. Please contact technical@southwarkplayhouse.co.uk.

Application Deadline: We are accepting applications and assessing applications on the basis of rolling assessment, therefore while there is no set closing date, this advert may close once a suitable number of applications which meet the job criteria have been received. You are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.
